newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 4,531 tonnes of zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 4,531 tonnes of zinc.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 4,531 tonnes, or 9,990,229 pounds, or zinc for $5,611,962, or an average price of 56.17 cents per pound.
Cash special high grade LME zinc settled officially at 54.29 cents per pound Tuesday.

The winning bidders for batches of high grade or prime western material were American Alloys, Sogem-Afrimet, Colwell Kennedy, Trademet, Parks Pioneer Corp, Tally Metal Sales, I Schumann and Co, and Sipi Metals Corp.
The next bid opening for zinc is scheduled for Tuesday, March 18, 1997.
